```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(knitr)
```

# Executive Summary

This document consolidates all generated research artifacts for Model A (dynamic crawler) and Model B (worker pool crawler).

# Inputs and Data Sources

```{r}
root <- params$root_dir
processed <- file.path(root, "processed")
reports <- file.path(root, "reports")
diagrams <- file.path(root, "diagrams")
meta <- file.path(root, "_meta")

cat("Root:", root, "\n")
cat("Processed:", processed, "\n")
cat("Reports:", reports, "\n")
cat("Diagrams:", diagrams, "\n")
cat("Meta:", meta, "\n")
```

# Core Comparison Table

```{r}
tbl_path <- file.path(processed, "comparison_table.csv")
if (file.exists(tbl_path)) {
  tbl <- read.csv(tbl_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  kable(tbl)
} else {
  cat("comparison_table.csv not found")
}
```

# Generated Diagrams

```{r}
imgs <- c(
  "throughput_comparison.png",
  "latency_comparison.png",
  "error_rate_comparison.png",
  "memory_comparison.png"
)

for (img in imgs) {
  p <- file.path(diagrams, img)
  if (file.exists(p)) {
    cat("\n##", img, "\n\n")
    knitr::include_graphics(p)
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

# Explicit Interpretation

```{r}
report_md <- file.path(reports, "report.md")
if (file.exists(report_md)) {
  lines <- readLines(report_md, warn = FALSE)
  cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
} else {
  cat("report.md not found")
}
```

# Reproducibility and Manifest

```{r}
manifest_path <- file.path(meta, "manifest.json")
if (file.exists(manifest_path)) {
  txt <- readLines(manifest_path, warn = FALSE)
  cat(paste(txt, collapse = "\n"))
} else {
  cat("manifest.json not found")
}
```
